prompt:
Redesign the GUARD'S COLOR PALETTE AND SHIELD as explicitly requested.
Image1 = exact male guard identity, compact proportions, face/hair/beard, costume construction, halberd and grounded left-three-quarter pose to retain.
Image2 = project defense gem reference for BLUE palette, broad protective shield shape and simplified planes.

BLUE CHARACTER PALETTE:
Replace the black/ochre-bronze primary clothing/armor scheme with clear COBALT BLUE / DEEP NAVY / muted STEEL-SILVER, small IVORY collar accents and minimal restrained old-gold hardware if needed. Blue must be the dominant visible main color, not a tiny trim on black. Shoulder guard, chest plate, skirt tabs and shin panels carry broad cobalt/slate-blue faces with deep navy shadows and quiet steel edges. Hair remains black with the existing ivory temple streak; natural skin and beard unchanged. Halberd metal fittings harmonize to cool steel and navy, no change to its shape or grip.

SHIELD — NEW NON-ROUND, LEFT-RIGHT SYMMETRIC DESIGN:
Completely REMOVE the old circular shield, tortoise/snake relief and bronze ring.
Replace with ONE LARGE BROAD-SHOULDERED HEATER/TOWER HYBRID SHIELD, inspired by image2's stout defensive gem silhouette: short gently peaked top center, matching chamfered upper corners, equal squared/widened shoulders on both sides, long clean side edges tapering into ONE BLUNT LOWER POINT. Clearly NOT round, oval or circular.
The physical shield design is BILATERALLY SYMMETRICAL about its vertical centerline: equal left/right shoulder steps, mirrored bevel thickness and matching face divisions. Present its front nearly facing camera, only a very slight perspective angle for believable arm mounting, so the symmetry is clearly visible. Don't make one edge a wing or add asymmetrical spikes.
Design is VERY SIMPLE: ONE broad cobalt-blue convex face, ONE clear central vertical ridge separating two wide planes, ONE plain steel-blue beveled border, at most one broad shallow V-shaped structural band. Only 3–5 main graphic regions total. No animal emblem, no big central jewel/medallion, no letters, tiny runes, studs, layered rings, filigree, scales or ornament clusters. Shield beauty comes from its sturdy silhouette and large face planes. Thick navy side edge gives real defensive mass.
Shield remains carried on the arm at SCREEN RIGHT, at similar useful size, slightly offset from body, with believable attachment behind. Full face/head, torso centerline and both boots visible.

Preserve the male identity and actual head/body ratio, calm protective pose and single halberd on screen-left. Both feet planted, all body direction coherent. Refit the shield arm only as needed.
Same PROJECT GEM ICON painting: bold dark contour, 2–3 big matte values per material, crisp broad folds/planes, no tiny facet mosaic, noisy texture, chrome glare, realistic glass or neon glow. One complete full-body guard on square plain warm ivory canvas with safe margins around halberd, new shield and boots. No text, panel or extra character.
purpose: User-directed blue palette and non-round, bilaterally symmetric simplified shield redesign.
visual_review: Dominant cobalt/navy costume with steel accents; round Xuanwu shield replaced by a broad-shouldered tapering blue shield with symmetric designed contour, simple central ridge and plain border.
